title: Unit footer
description: A calm white footer: grey-labelled link columns (four per row on desktop, two on phones) beside a right column with a tinted email field and arrow, a social row and a row of two round seals between hairlines. Then a bar between hairlines with a big bold lowercase wordmark and grey legal links (centred on phones), and grey fine-print paragraphs with the copyright.
notes: social icons come in as props (the demo uses Tabler brand icons)
media slots: the certification seals (48px circles)
the submit button tints with the highlight colour on hover
